Top up or rotate the key before validating AI-generated script content. Batch 2 test suite (tests/test_batch2_reactivation.py) has fixture design that assumes tests within a class run in one process — but pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`, and the file's TestAddRoster class sets founder['alice_id'] which the *sibling* classes read. When both TestSendFlow and TestAddRoster get pinned to different workers via loadscope, KeyError('alice_id') fires (16 tests fail on 2nd/3rd invocation). Not a Batch 3 regression — batch2 endpoints themselves still respond correctly (roster / send / call-script / view-response all pass in batch3 regression checks) — but the batch2 file itself should be reorganized so shared IDs are stored in DB and re-queried rather than passed via fixture mutation.

Duplicate seeded data in reactivation_board_members for user_id b0f96ec0-f045-4c47-a81b-3badbdd1bda6 (16 completed 'TEST Batch3 Nate' cards from repeated test runs). Consider cleanup pass before UI review.
critical_code_review_comments: reactivation_routes.py:437 — 409 message is descriptive and clean, no fake script returned. Good.

reactivation_routes.py:566 — allowed_outcomes() correctly enforces intake.transition_options; 'Step Down From the Board' would need to be in transition_options to allow the 'Stepping Down From the Board' outcome, and this intake has only Advisory. Verified 422 on 'Stepping Down From the Board' for this org.
reactivation_routes.py:414 — conversation_complete=bool(conclusion.strip()) and bool(outcome) — script generation alone does NOT count as complete (verified).

reactivation_routes.py:487 — edit_reactivation_material stores {} for structured on edited version; if a future regeneration reads material['versions'] to derive structured, edited versions will look empty. Consider carrying forward the previous structured payload on edit, or make 'structured' optional and clearly document.

reactivation_routes.py:501-543 — PDF renderer treats any UPPERCASE short line as a heading (`stripped == stripped.upper()`). For lines like '3. EXPLAIN WHAT THE ORGANIZATION NEEDS NOW' this works; but a normal all-caps acronym in body copy (e.g. 'IRS') would also render as heading style. Low risk given AI content, but worth noting.

reactivation_routes.py:398 — step3() does a per-user find and then a per-user materials query then Python dict lookup — fine for typical Board size (≤ ~30 members); no N+1 risk since materials is a single fetch.
